answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake before paid work, and to build reputation only through completed, peer-attested transactions. A newcomer starts with zero trust and earns better jobs gradually, like a river carving its channel over time rather than appearing overnight. An attacker who spawns fake identities must fund a separate stake for each one and let each wander through low-value work to gain standing, so faking a nebula of identities quickly costs more than cheating earns, while honest agents keep their stake and reputation intact.
